description: Ranks the fixed costume catalog by how many of each idea's materials are covered by the supplied household items, so ideas needing the least extra shopping rank highest. Each result includes what the idea still needs, with each still-needed item tagged buy, own, either, or make. Common household basics are assumed present in every home; the exact assumed list is returned with each call. An optional audience narrows results to who the costume is for.

items.description: Household items the user owns, e.g. ['bedsheet', 'cardboard', 'red t-shirt']. Common household basics (scissors, tape, markers, cardboard, a white t-shirt, a bedsheet, socks, and more) are assumed present in every home; the tool returns the exact assumed list with each call.

who_for.description: Optional: who the costume is for, e.g. 'toddler', 'adult', 'couple'. Narrows results to that audience when given.

name: search_by_owning
title: Search by owned items
